🏠 Menu

🔍 Spot the mistake

Is the student right? Find the mistake. Chat first, then click!

1

Sam: "£60 increased by 10% is £6."

✗ He forgot to ADD it on.

✓ £60 + £6 = £66

2

Mia: "£200 up 5% is 0.5 × 200 = £100."

✗ 5% is 0.05, and up needs 1.05.

✓ 1.05 × 200 = £210

3

Zak: "£80 down 25%, then up 25%, is £80."

✗ The second 25% is of £60.

✓ £60 + £15 = £75

Add it on. Up 5% is × 1.05.
